input.title: [iOS] Multiline thought jumps on setCursor
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
- b
- c
- Why does this thought jump? But only if it is a multiline thought.
```

1. Make sure you are scrolled all the way to the top. 
2. Move the cursor between the multiline thought and `c`.

## Current Behavior

The thought quickly jumps up and back. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/783c5ca0-5841-4135-9647-6ca0da05649b

Note: This does depend on the space above the multiline thought. Notice that if you scroll down a little it no longer jumps. If you add additional thoughts above the multiline thought it jumps to a different place. 

This may be related to preventAutofocus. 

## Expected Behavior

The thought should not move.
